title: Claymation — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea to system
scenes.purpose: A clay idea-bulb character sprouts rolled clay coils that press in nodes and close into a connected system, shot as stepped clay exposures.
visuals: Flat dusty-cerulean painted backdrop card with soft falloff and stationary grain
Terracotta clay bulb-head with charcoal bead eyes, replacement mouths and sage/charcoal rolled base
Five sage clay coils and four hand-rolled nodes (sage, charcoal, terracotta, sage) with soft contact shadows on the card
Charcoal digital title panel with cream lettering

beats.development: Title panel fades in as one group; the idea bulb is pressed onto the set with squash-and-stretch overshoot.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Blink, lean back and 'oh' replacement mouth; two coils push out of the bulb and the first two nodes pop in where they land.
Coils branch to two more nodes, then a final coil links them into a closed loop; the character straightens and switches to a smile.
Settled held exposure of the completed system with no boil; title remains fully legible.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Title is fully legible from 0.45s and stays static for the remainder.
Clay poses step at 12 exposures/s; all motion settles by 2.45s, before the 2.7s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.35–3.0s final hold lets the viewer read the completed connected system and title.

notes: Digital simulation of clay animation using Three.js; Blender not used per user instruction.
No preview_recipes were supplied in STYLE.json; the refresh demonstrates the primary style with a scene-dependent painted backdrop.
